title: Render script regenerates all generated sections from registry

brief.why: brigade.toml and markers are only useful if a script reads the registry and writes the correct content between them — this is the core automation.
brief.what: 1. Create scripts/render.py as PEP 723 script (uv run --script) with jinja2 dep declared inline 2. Read brigade.toml with tomllib 3. Jinja2 templates for brigade-table rows (README/index format) and for-agents tables (vocab, routing, deps, repos) 4. For each target file: read, find START/END markers by name, replace content between them, write back 5. Script idempotent — safe to run repeatedly
brief.done: uv run --script scripts/render.py updates all GENERATED sections in README.md, docs/index.md, docs/for-agents.md; re-running produces no diff
